narrative.overview:
Shotviva is a darkroom for a phone photo. The room is warm black, never blue and never pure black; type is the colour of bone paper; and the one light in the room is the safelight, a hot red-orange that marks what to press, what the AI made, and what is developing right now. The user's photo is the print in the tray: the interface is dark and quiet so the image is the brightest, most colourful thing on screen. A single static film-grain layer sits over everything, the way a darkroom print carries grain; it never moves.

The language of the room runs through the product. Uploading is framed in a viewfinder with four corner brackets and a 4:5 readout; generating is "Developing", shown as a greyed negative turning positive under a safelight scan line; finished photos land in Photos. Display type is Instrument Serif, a narrow editorial serif with an italic used for one emphasised phrase per headline; everything you read or tap is Geist; and Geist Mono is kept for real measurements only (credits, px, ratios, percentages, per-credit prices). Edges are drawn as 1px inset hairlines in bone at 9%, not as borders or drop shadows.

The system behaves like a native iOS app on mobile web: a large serif title on tab roots, a bottom tab bar there, flow pages with a back link and one fixed bottom action, bottom sheets for every overlay, and press feedback (scale) on every tappable surface. The paywall is the one place colour widens: three tiers are told apart by material, matte graphite, sapphire glass, black and gold.
keyCharacteristics: Warm black ground, bone type, one safelight accent; the photo carries all other colour.
One static film-grain overlay at 7% opacity, never animated.
Instrument Serif for display (sentence case, one italic phrase), Geist for UI, Geist Mono only for measurements.
Edges are inset 1px hairlines; depth comes from tone steps and two drop levels.
Every template card is a split at rest: phone photo left, AI result right.
One filled full-width primary per screen, in the thumb zone.
Paywall tiers are materials: graphite, sapphire glass, black and gold.

rules.name: The One Safelight Rule
rules.body: Safelight is the only chromatic UI colour outside the paywall tiers. It marks the primary action, the AI side, the current place and live progress; it is never a background wash behind body text and never decoration.

rules.name: The 13px→14px Contrast Rule
rules.body: Captions are at least 14px, and Ash or Bone Dim text holds at least 4.5:1 on every surface it sits on, including every point of each paywall tier. Check the lightest point of a gradient or overlay, not its base. Never dim muted text further with opacity.

rules.name: The 16px Input Rule
rules.body: Every input and textarea renders its text at 16px or larger, so iOS never zooms the page. Placeholders sit in the same 16px.

rules.name: The Measurement Mono Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono appears only on real measurements: a cost, a size, a ratio, a count, a percentage. Words never go in mono.

rules.name: The One Italic Rule
rules.body: A serif headline may italicise one phrase. Display type is never bold and never all caps.

rules.name: The One Primary Rule
rules.body: Each screen has exactly one filled, full-width primary, 56px tall, in the bottom thumb zone (or the generator card on the homepage). The homepage's floating dock repeats the generator's own primary and shows only while the generator is off-screen, so the two are never visible together. Every other action is ghost, quiet or a link.

rules.name: The Inset Hairline Rule
rules.body: Edges are inset 1px bone strokes, never CSS borders on cards and never coloured outlines at rest.

rules.name: The Static Grain Rule
rules.body: One film-grain layer over the whole page, fixed, non-interactive, never animated.

rules.name: The Always-Visible Split Rule
rules.body: A template card shows the phone photo and the AI result at the same time, at rest, labelled "Phone" and "AI". No toggle, no hover, nothing to tap first. The homepage generator and the preview sheet use the same two words.

rules.name: The Quiet Loop Rule
rules.body: A template video is muted, loops, plays inline and shows no controls. It plays only while it is in view and pauses when it leaves. The poster frame (the split image) shows first and the video loads after. With reduced motion, only the poster is shown and it never plays.

rules.name: The Tier Materials Rule
rules.body: Starter is matte graphite: flat, hairline, no light. Pro is sapphire glass: a deep blue gradient with a corner light, a cool rim and a top highlight, its name in Sapphire Ink, the only flag in solid Sapphire. Max is black and gold: a black gradient with a gold corner light, a gold-foil rim that turns slowly and a slow sheen, its name and price in solid Max Gold, gold check, gold-foil flag, gold-foil checkout. Under reduced motion the rim and sheen hold still.

rules.name: The Live Perks Rule
rules.body: Each tier lists only perks that are live today, under "Includes" or "Everything in X, plus", with a check. Perks that are not live sit below in their own group headed "Coming soon", in Ash caption text without checks, never mixed into the live list. Tier copy never promises queue priority or faster generation.

rules.name: The Credits Unit Rule
rules.body: Prices, charges and balances are always in credits: "Generate · 2 credits", "from 2 credits", "$0.23/credit", "6 free". The phrase "3 free Standard images" appears only on the marketing page, the sign-up prompt and the FAQ; inside the app the gift is "6 free credits".

dos: **Do** keep one filled, full-width, 56px primary per screen in the thumb zone (The One Primary Rule).
**Do** set every input and textarea at 16px or larger (The 16px Input Rule).
**Do** keep every caption at 14px or larger and measure Ash and Bone Dim at 4.5:1 or better on the lightest point of every surface, including each paywall tier (The 13px→14px Contrast Rule).
**Do** show every template card as a split at rest with "Phone" and "AI" tags (The Always-Visible Split Rule).
**Do** play template videos muted, looped, inline, without controls, only while in view, poster first, poster only under reduced motion (The Quiet Loop Rule).
**Do** write prices, charges and balances in credits; keep "3 free Standard images" to the marketing page, sign-up prompt and FAQ (The Credits Unit Rule).
**Do** tell tiers apart by material: graphite, sapphire glass, black and gold with solid gold type and a gold rim (The Tier Materials Rule).
**Do** list only live perks with checks and put the rest in a separate grey "Coming soon" group (The Live Perks Rule).
**Do** draw edges as inset 1px bone hairlines and keep drop shadows to the Raised and Sheet levels.
**Do** map each component to shadcn/ui (new-york) or a 规范 §2 self-built component, using the `:root` variables, not literal colours.
donts: **Don't** use Safelight as a wash behind body text or as decoration; it marks action, the AI side, the current place and live progress.
**Don't** put a second filled button on a screen that already has its primary.
**Don't** dim Ash text with opacity, and don't run a sheen or gradient light behind text where it drops below 4.5:1.
**Don't** add a before/after toggle, a hover reveal or a media-type badge to still template cards.
**Don't** autoplay video that is off-screen, or play it at all under reduced motion.
**Don't** mix "Coming soon" perks into the live list, and don't claim queue priority or faster generation on any tier.
**Don't** set display type bold or in capitals.
